en.title: How your child's teeth grow: ages 6 to 12

sentences.text: This model shows the right side of a child's jaws at 6 years.
Baby teeth are blue and adult teeth are yellow.
Each adult tooth starts as a crown deep in the jaw. As its root grows, it moves toward the gum.
As it moves up, the root of the baby tooth melts away. The baby tooth gets loose and falls out.
The first adult molars come at about 6, and the second molars at about 12.
Every child is different. Teeth often come a year or more earlier or later, and this is usually normal.
